movies.title: Fantastic Planet
movies.description: On a distant planet, giant blue aliens keep humans as tiny pets. A surreal, beautifully animated cult classic about revolution and survival.

movies.title: Night of the Living Dead
movies.description: A group of people hide in a farmhouse to survive the night as the dead mysteriously come back to life and hunt the living.

movies.title: The Fast and the Furious
movies.description: A man wrongly imprisoned for murder breaks out of jail and takes a beautiful woman hostage as he slips into a cross-border sports car race to escape to Mexico.

movies.title: The General
movies.description: During the Civil War, an engineer is rejected for service but proves his heroism when his beloved steam engine, The General, is stolen by spies.

movies.title: His Girl Friday
movies.description: A hard-boiled newspaper editor tries to keep his ace reporter ex-wife from remarrying by entangling her in a massive story about a convicted murderer.

movies.title: The Last Man on Earth
movies.description: Dr. Robert Morgan is the only survivor of a devastating plague that has turned the rest of humanity into vampire-like creatures. The first and most faithful adaptation of 'I Am Legend'.

movies.title: Bloody Wednesday
movies.description: An auto mechanic descends into madness after losing his job and marriage. Released from a mental hospital, he moves into an abandoned hotel where hallucinations drive him toward a violent breaking point.

movies.title: Savage Weekend
movies.description: Several couples head upstate to watch a boat being built, but their weekend getaway turns deadly when they are stalked by a masked killer. An early slasher that predates Halloween.

movies.title: Santa Claus Conquers the Martians
movies.description: Martians kidnap Santa Claus and two Earth children to bring joy to the children of Mars. A cult classic known for being so bad it's good.

movies.title: Steamboat Bill, Jr.
movies.description: The effete son of a rugged riverboat captain tries to prove himself to his father during a massive cyclone. Features Buster Keaton's most famous and dangerous stunt with a falling house wall.

shows.title: The Dick Van Dyke Show
shows.description: A classic sitcom following the work and home life of television comedy writer Rob Petrie.

episodes.name: The Sick Boy and the Sitter

shows.title: Dragnet
shows.description: Just the facts, ma'am. Follow Sergeant Joe Friday as he investigates various crimes in Los Angeles.

shows.title: One Step Beyond
shows.description: An anthology series focused on the paranormal and psychic phenomena.

shows.title: The Beverly Hillbillies
shows.description: A poor backwoods family strikes oil and moves to the posh neighborhood of Beverly Hills.

shows.title: Bonanza
shows.description: The adventures of the Cartwright family on their massive ranch, the Ponderosa.
